location.zh: 街角的泡泡自助洗衣店

goal.en: Figure out the machines, get some coins and buy detergent.
goal.zh: 搞懂洗衣機怎麼用，換到零錢，再買到洗衣精。

background: bright laundromat with a long row of front-loading washing machines, stacked dryers, a wooden folding table, empty plastic laundry baskets, checkered floor, sunny Sunday afternoon

intro.en: Your laundry basket is overflowing. Mia takes you to the laundromat down the street.
intro.zh: 你的髒衣籃已經滿出來了。米亞帶你去街角的自助洗衣店。

intro.en: Laundry day! I'll grab us two machines. You handle the rest, okay?
intro.zh: 洗衣日！我去佔兩台洗衣機，其他的交給你囉？

intro.en: The machines look brand new, with buttons you've never seen before.
intro.zh: 洗衣機看起來是全新的，上面的按鈕你一個都沒看過。

lines.en: Hi there, you two! First time here?

choices.en: Yes. How does this machine work?
choices.tip: How does this machine work? 是問操作方式的標準句，任何機器都適用。

choices.en: Yes. How to use this machine?

lines.en: How to use...? Sorry, what about it?
lines.zh: 怎麼用……？抱歉，你是說什麼？

story.en: She starts explaining the dryers instead. Twenty minutes later, you're a dryer expert, and your clothes are still dirty.
story.zh: 她開始解釋烘衣機怎麼用。二十分鐘後，你成了烘衣機專家，衣服卻還是髒的。

fail.why: How to use? 是中文「怎麼用？」的直譯，在英文裡不是完整的問句。要說 How does this machine work? 或 How do I use this machine?。

choices.en: Yes. Teach me how to use it.

lines.en: Teach you? My, aren't we bossy today.
lines.zh: 教你？哎呀，今天口氣真大。

story.en: She points at the instructions on the wall and goes back to her crossword. Mia presses random buttons until something beeps.
story.zh: 她指了指牆上的說明，就回去玩她的填字遊戲。米亞隨便亂按，直到機器「嗶」了一聲。

fail.why: Teach me... 是命令句，對陌生人說很沒禮貌。請人說明時用問句：How does this machine work? 或 Could you show me how to use it?。

lines.en: Easy. Pick a program, then put in four dollars in coins.
lines.zh: 很簡單。選好洗程，再投四塊錢硬幣就行了。

lines.en: You check your wallet. Just one ten-dollar bill.
lines.zh: 你翻翻錢包，只有一張十元紙鈔。

lines.en: Oh, and the change machine is broken today. Sorry!
lines.zh: 對了，今天換幣機壞了，抱歉！

choices.en: Do you have change for a ten?
choices.zh: 你可以幫我換開十元嗎？
choices.tip: change 當名詞是「零錢」，change for a ten 就是「把十元鈔換開」。

choices.en: Can you change me small money?

lines.en: Change you? Small money? Sorry, I don't follow.
lines.zh: 換你？小錢？抱歉，我聽不懂。

story.en: After three tries, Mia digs through her bag and finds exactly four dollars in coins. Now you owe her, and she will remember.
story.zh: 試了三次都說不通，米亞只好在包包裡翻出剛好四塊錢的硬幣。現在你欠她一次，她一定會記得。

fail.why: 「換零錢」不能直譯成 change me small money。要說 Do you have change for a ten?，change 本身就是「零錢」的意思。

choices.en: Do you have changes for ten?

lines.en: Changes? Oh, lots of changes here since 1985!
lines.zh: 改變？喔，這裡從 1985 年到現在可改變多了！

story.en: She tells you the whole history of the laundromat. It's a lovely story, but your clothes are still waiting in the basket.
story.zh: 她把洗衣店的歷史從頭講了一遍。故事很溫馨，但你的衣服還躺在籃子裡等你。

fail.why: 表示「零錢」的 change 不可數，不加 s；加了 s 的 changes 是「改變」。要說 Do you have change for a ten?。

lines.en: Oh no! I left the detergent at home!
lines.zh: 糟了！我把洗衣精忘在家裡了！

lines.en: No worries, I sell it here. What do you need?
lines.zh: 別擔心，我這裡有賣。你們要什麼？

choices.tip: detergent 是洗衣精、洗衣粉的總稱，a pack of... 是「一包……」。

choices.en: Two packs of washing clothes powder.

lines.en: Washing... clothes powder? Do you mean soap? Bleach?
lines.zh: 洗衣服……粉？你是說肥皂？還是漂白劑？

story.en: You nod at the wrong word and get bleach. Your favorite black hoodie comes out with brand-new white spots.
story.zh: 你在錯的字上點了頭，拿到的是漂白劑。你最愛的黑色帽 T 洗完多了一堆白色斑點。

fail.why: 「洗衣粉」不能逐字翻成 washing clothes powder。洗衣精、洗衣粉英文都叫 detergent：Two packs of detergent, please.。

choices.en: Can we just use that bottle there?
choices.zh: 我們可以直接用那邊那瓶嗎？

lines.en: That belongs to another customer! Hands off, please.
lines.zh: 那是別的客人的！請不要動。

story.en: The bottle's owner walks in at that exact moment. You spend the next hour avoiding eye contact by the dryers.
story.zh: 瓶子的主人剛好在這時走進來。接下來一個小時，你在烘衣機旁邊努力避開對方的眼神。

fail.why: 自助洗衣店裡別人放著的東西，就算看起來沒人管，也不能擅自使用。需要就直接買：Two packs of detergent, please.。

lines.en: Two packs, coming right up. You two make a good team!
lines.zh: 兩包，馬上來。你們兩個真是好搭檔！

lines.en: See? Next time, you're the laundry expert!
lines.zh: 看吧？下次就換你當洗衣專家了！

story.en: An hour later, your clothes come out warm and soft. Even your socks smell like spring.
story.zh: 一個小時後，衣服又暖又軟地出爐，連襪子都有春天的味道。

notes.explain: 問操作方式的萬用句，洗衣機、售票機、咖啡機都適用。也可以說 How do I use this?。

example.en: Excuse me, how does this ticket machine work?
example.zh: 不好意思，這台售票機怎麼用？

notes.en: Do you have change for a ten?
notes.explain: change 當名詞是「零錢」，不可數。a ten 是「一張十元鈔」，a twenty 就是二十元鈔。

example.en: Do you have change for a twenty? I need coins for the bus.
example.zh: 可以幫我換開二十元嗎？我搭公車需要硬幣。

notes.explain: 洗衣用的清潔劑統稱 detergent，粉狀是 powder，液態是 liquid。fabric softener 是「柔軟精」。

example.en: Do you sell detergent and fabric softener?
example.zh: 你們有賣洗衣精和柔軟精嗎？

notes.explain: How to...? 在英文裡不是完整問句，要加上助動詞和主詞：How do I use this?、How does it work?。

example.en: How do I use this dryer?

notes.explain: 不要動別人的東西，衣服洗好要盡快取出，別讓下一位等。真的需要移動別人的衣物，先問店員。

example.zh: 請問有人在用這台烘衣機嗎？
